notes.title: Legend of Himari 2.0: Steam items, altered gameplay, two new heroes

tags.feature: The player's character can now make a dash and move freely through the level.
There have also been significant balance edits, two new characters added, Steam items, and rich presence!
You can now move freely left and right around the location;
You now have the ability to make a dash;
After defeating a boss, you can choose one of three upgrades;
Two new characters
Steam items in the form of hats that can be put on the character with different bonuses (drop after a certain amount of time in the game after defeating a boss);

tags.balance_change: When taking damage, the combo now resets, but the combo scale decreases more slowly;
Bosses now appear every 8 levels instead of 10;
The character now does not take re-damage while the screen is still red from damage;
The chance of stars falling out is much stronger increasing with each level, but less initially;
Changed and improved Combo Master perk;
Changed the balance in the strength of enemies;
Enemies now have more health with each level;
Enemies are more repulsed when taking damage;

tags.feature: New record table for the new balsan (the old version of the game remains available).
Redrawn Warai-kun animation;
Slightly redrawn animations of other characters;
Added stroke to sprites and attack animations;
You can see the strength of the damage dealt to enemies;
Steam Rich Presence showing the mode you're playing in and your score;
A brief introduction of the new game features has been added before you start the game.

tags.bug: Music does not disappear after the levels start to run in circles;
The game is now paused if the window is inactive;
Can't double the attack rate by pressing left-right;
Improved gamepad control: now pauses and you can play on the arrows.

notes.title: Taimumari five-year anniversary and update to Definitive Edition
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25363761/02592ac56fab21f3686b5c2c9deb0925525258ea.jpg[/img]
On December 16, 2015 I released my first commercial game - [b]Taimumari[/b]. It was not a perfect and polished game, but it was my dream. With Taimumari I was able to leave my office work and realize my projects.

And today, five years later, the game gets a major upgrade, straight from the consoles. I hope you will be pleased with the new graphics in the dialogues. If you wish, you can also play the classic version. https://store.steampowered.com/app/375520
The new Definitive Edition also includes an addition with Kanashimi, which now does not need to be purchased separately.

I am also developing Taimumari 2 and unfortunately I was not able to release it by the fifth anniversary as planned. There's still a lot of work to do, so I don't know when I can release it yet. https://store.steampowered.com/app/1292400
However, my small BakuMari project will be released soon - you can check out its Steam page now. https://store.steampowered.com/app/1470880/BakuMari
I appreciate your support and hope that you will also play my future games. [b]Thank you all![/b]

tags.feature: The new Definitive Edition also includes an addition with Kanashimi, which now does not need to be purchased separately.
